description: Defines the ContactForm entity class for Drupal, including its properties, annotations, and methods for managing contact form configurations.

classes.name: ContactForm
classes.description: Represents a configurable contact form entity with properties like message, recipients, redirect, reply, and weight, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message displayed on form submission.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message displayed on form submission.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns the list of recipient email addresses.

methods.name: setRecipients
methods.description: Sets the list of recipient email addresses.

methods.name: getRedirectPath
methods.description: Returns the redirect path after form submission.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL object for redirection, defaulting to front page if none set.

methods.name: setRedirectPath
methods.description: Sets the redirect path after form submission.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the contact form.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the contact form.
